# John Zialcita – Jumbo Refinance in Hawaii & California

> John Zialcita is a mortgage broker (NMLS #337891; California DRE Broker License #01727126) with Loan Factory, Inc. (NMLS #320841). He arranges jumbo rate-and-term and cash-out refinances for homeowners in Hawaii and California. Phone/text: (415) 385-7409. Email: john.zialcita@loanfactory.com. Office: Loan Factory, Inc., 2195 Tully Road, San Jose, CA 95122.

Last updated: 2026-10-20. Hawaii license details are pending verification on NMLS Consumer Access.
